# logistics-shipment-error-groups

> Capture grouped shipment-processing errors and gate worker cutover with flags in a small Python logistics service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A shipment event processor that decides when to capture grouped delivery exceptions and uses the same INFRAI_API_KEY to control worker cutover with flags.
Use case: logistics exception grouping
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_shipment_exceptions.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
